$comment: Physical Security Zones Attestation. Rows come from PS_Zone-Attestation-Assignments (filtered to the signed-in user's email). Each row shows the area's current zone (CurrentZone) to confirm, or to change through the dropdown, and saves one item to PS_Zone-Attestation-Responses: ZoneSelection = the answer, PreviousZone = the current zone, ZoneChanged = whether they differ. An area with no CurrentZone gets the dropdown straight away. Both lists live on /teams/FCUWebDatastores (target.siteUrl and source.siteUrl); the page runs on /sites/FCUPortal. Users need read on the Assignments list and Add + View (own items only) on Responses. Set form.vars.jobAidUrl to show the job aid card. Bilingual: every { en, fr } pair follows the language from bilingual/intl.js. Zone VALUES (Public, Public Plus, Standards, Secure Restricted, High Security) are saved in English whatever the language, and CurrentZone must hold them spelled exactly so; only the labels are translated. The French zone names and all the zone descriptions are drafts, to be replaced.
